title: Cock, Paper, Scissors

publisher.name: ONE Archives at the USC Libraries in collaboration with the Leslie-Lohman Museum of Gay and Lesbian Art

description.main: Catalogue of a 2016 ONE Archives exhibition of collage by fifteen queer artists.
description.extended:
Cock, Paper, Scissors is the catalogue of a 2016 exhibition on queer collage, from the gay liberation era to the present.

The book presents work by fifteen queer artists across generations who cut and reassemble printed matter for what the publisher calls worldmaking. It combines curatorial introductions, artist interviews and reprinted historical texts, among them writing by Glenn Ligon and by Melissa Meyer with Miriam Schapiro. ONE Archives at the USC Libraries published it with the Leslie-Lohman Museum of Gay and Lesbian Art. It is a full-color hardcover of 152 pages, designed by Kimberly Varella of Content Object.

David Evans Frantz, Lucas Hilderbrand and Kayleigh Perkov edited the volume.
description.exhibition_context: Accompanies Cock, Paper, Scissors, ONE Archives, 2016.
